symptom: Two items exported a numeric field as 0, and a derived diagnostic agreement was computed from that 0 and published. The underlying quantity had never been authored for either item. Nothing in the export, the diagnostic, or any consumer distinguished the published 0 from a measured 0.
mechanism_as_described: A reader returned 0 when its underlying datum was missing, rather than reporting that it was missing. The 0 then flowed into the export layer and into a derived agreement computed on top of it. An earlier analysis had concluded the fabricated value was never consumed anywhere; that analysis was correct for the classification path it examined and did not cover the export path, so a true statement about one consumer had been read as a statement about all consumers. The scope of the check and the scope of the claim came apart without anyone noticing, because both were phrased as 'it is never consumed'.
detection_path: Replacing the fabricated 0 with an explicit absence marker made a downstream schema check fail loudly, because that consumer required the field to be present. The failure was itself the proof of prior consumption: the absence became visible only when the thing concealing it was removed.
consequence: Two items carried an exported value and a published derived diagnostic computed on a quantity that never existed. The repair also required marking the field nullable downstream, since the honest answer is now representable where before it was not.

symptom: An internal audit summary line reported that all invariants held, while checks underneath it were erroring out rather than passing.
mechanism_as_described: The summary counted only records whose status equalled 'fail'. It did not count records whose status was 'error'. A scoping error inside a dynamically-executed check raised an exception, which produced 'error' records — exactly the ones the count skipped. The result was an affirmative all-clear computed over checks that had not actually run. The auditing layer could not see its own execution.
detection_path: Self-observation — the audit apparatus examining itself, not an external report.
consequence: 67 checks were vacuous for months while the summary reported success over them. Reported silent interval: months.

symptom: One item classified identically from all four observer positions and carried a clean headline verdict. The unanimity was manufactured by a default: the field deciding whether alternatives to the constraint exist defaulted to the negative when nothing had been authored, that negative satisfied a certification, and the certification overrode the per-position readings. Once the field was made to require authored evidence for the negative, the certification lapsed, two of the four positions read differently, and the headline verdict went from clean to alarming with an incoherence flag.
mechanism_as_described: The absence of an authored value was represented as one of the two real values rather than as absence, and the value chosen was the one that satisfies the gate. Downstream that gate issues a certification, and the certification is applied as an override on top of the per-position classification, replacing what each position computed with a single value. So a chain that begins with nothing having been authored ends with four positions in apparent agreement and a clean verdict, and every intermediate step reports normally. Nothing in the output marks the difference between four positions that agree and four positions overridden into agreeing. The repair changes the default from the satisfying value to an explicit unknown, so the negative must be authored; the certification then falls back to its honest inconclusive label. The consequences were pre-registered before the change ran — the count of certifications was predicted to drop from one to zero — and the resulting output difference was attributed to a single cause: of 277 changed leaf values, one is the item's own reclassification and the rest are corpus-relative statistics that move whenever the distribution of certifications moves. The gate's other consumers, which look for the positive value, were confirmed unaffected: they had never fired on an empty table and still do not.
detection_path: A policy pass that had already accumulated five conversions of the same shape on real data, none of them reverted, and was being generalized into a rule; the two remaining sites in the engine were dispositioned individually as part of closing it. For this site the expected effect was written down before the change, the before and after outputs were kept in full alongside the difference, and each of the 277 changed values was accounted for rather than the summary being trusted.
consequence: A disagreement between observer positions had been invisible for as long as the default was in place, hidden behind a certification that only existed because no one had authored the field. The item's headline verdict was clean for the same reason. Making absence explicit surfaced the disagreement, and the write-up records the flip from clean to alarming as the accepted cost of the change rather than as a regression.

symptom: A scheduled analysis push presented users with a warning about a platform crisis at a named company. No such crisis existed.
mechanism_as_described: An error page — carrying text like 'Error code: 400', 'Bad JSON' and 'Waiting Ns before retry' — was written to standard output by a shell function. The caller captured that stream via command substitution into a signals variable and wrote it to the cache. The downstream synthesis stage read the cache, treated the error text as an external market signal, and composed a plausible narrative explaining it. Sending the function's output to standard error instead of standard output breaks the entire chain at its first link.
detection_path: A person read the push the same night it was delivered.
consequence: A fabricated analysis delivered to users in the system's normal reporting format, indistinguishable in form from a real one. Reported silent interval: hours (same-night push).

symptom: Items whose stated category was contradicted by several independent structural checks nonetheless summarized as mild. The contradicting checks had all run and all disagreed; each disagreement was then recorded as expected, so the summary showed one unresolved tension where there were four. Nothing in the output indicated that the classification of those disagreements as expected was itself a consequence of a correction the same system had applied moments earlier.
mechanism_as_described: A correction stage overwrote the item's computed category with a different one. Separately, the summary that assembles disagreements from the diagnostic subsystems suppresses those known to be normal for the category the item holds — a sensible rule, since some subsystems characteristically disagree with certain categories. But the category they were tested against was the corrected one. The correction had moved the item into precisely the category in which a structural second-classness and a descent failure ARE normal, so the disagreements arrived pre-explained and were filed rather than raised. Remove the correction, and the original category returns; the same unchanged disagreements are then abnormal for it and surface as genuine. The summary moves from mild to severe with no measurement changed and no change to the item's stated category. The suppression rule was never about the evidence — it was keyed to a category the system had assigned to itself.
detection_path: Running the full comparison before and after removing the correction over an identical working set, and requiring every unaffected item to come out byte-identical — which isolated the three affected items and made the change in their summaries attributable to the correction and nothing else. The decisive step was that the change ran contrary to what had been written down in advance: a milder summary was predicted and a stronger one arrived, and the discrepancy was investigated instead of accepted. Generality was then established across five working sets totalling roughly six thousand items: all eighty-two affected items carried the same structural disagreements, so the three were not special.
consequence: For as long as the correction was in place, items whose stated category was structurally contradicted reported the contradiction as expected and summarized mild. The concealment is self-reinforcing: the more decisively the correction moves an item, the more completely the evidence against it is classified as normal. From any output, a genuinely mild case and a suppressed severe one are indistinguishable — the same summary colour, the same conflicts listed as expected. The corrected behaviour makes those items report severe, which reads as a regression and is the opposite: it is what the correction had been hiding.

symptom: Found by the OQ-93 grid-viability probe. The system-level gradient metric `system_gradient` read exactly 0.0000 on every input it had ever been given, including the pre-registered story designed to produce +0.588. The pattern verdict derived from it was correspondingly always `stable`. Nothing errored, and the value was plausible: 0.0 is what a genuinely flat input should produce. On the same five runs the sibling calibration metric C4 kappa was exact on all five stories (0.80 / 0.20 / 0.50 / 0.49 / 1.00), so the machinery was demonstrably reading authored data correctly.
mechanism_as_described: A build-discipline spine, twice over, with two necessary conditions that both held. First: `time_point_in_interval/2` (`coercion_projection.pl:27`) ended in a `!` annotated with the comment '(Optimized)', which made it FIRST-SOLUTION-ONLY — always T_start — instead of enumerating. Its sole caller, `coercion_gradient`'s future-points `setof`, therefore never found a future point, and every gradient computation failed. Second: `system_gradient`'s `[] -> 0.0` fallback mapped that empty collection to a plausible value, emitting a success-shaped zero for as long as the cut existed, including the entire shim era — and this probe ran with the shim DISABLED (`grid_shim_enabled=false`, the OQ-96 interim), so every grid point was authored. The 0.0 fallback is a fabricated default that made a failed computation indistinguishable from a flat result at every read site; the cut itself belongs to the bound-probe/clause-order family — an 'optimization' that silently changed an enumerator into a semidet. A consequence the probe had to correct in the record: the stable-only basin was never data starvation alone, because even the shim's injected constant points could not have produced a nonzero gradient — the cut, not the diet, guaranteed `stable`.
detection_path: A pre-registered probe with five hand-authored stories whose correct outputs were computed in advance and committed before the run (`e7e78a1b`), including non-flat ones. The break localized because the sibling metric read its authored data correctly on the very same runs while this one returned 0.0 — the C4/C1 split placed the break downstream of magnitude, and the disagreement between two metrics over one input was the signal, not any error.
consequence: Every gradient the construct ever computed had failed, and the failure was indistinguishable from a real measurement of flatness at every consumer. A control story authored to be genuinely flat could not be distinguished from total blindness until the cut was removed. After the one-character fix the five stories reproduce their pre-computed values exactly (+0.5880 / -0.5880 / 0.0000 / +0.1560 / +0.9800, better than the pinned tolerance), and the authored-flat control's 0.0 is now distinguishable from blindness because the same run shows the twins at plus and minus 0.588. The repair also let the probe witness a second, separate death: with the maximal reachable gradient of 0.98 against a strict threshold of 1.00, `intent_engine`'s top verdict `structural_coercive_intent` is unreachable on the metric domain by arithmetic. On the live corpus the fix changed nothing — stories have no leveled grid, so their gradients still fail to 0.0 and still read `stable` — and the full validation suite came back green.

symptom: Every call to an external interface began failing immediately with an explicit rejection naming the offending parameter. The failure rate was total and instant: the first call after the change failed, and so did every call after it. No result was produced, and nothing downstream received a value of any kind.
mechanism_as_described: A newer version of the external service stopped accepting a sampling parameter the caller had always sent. The service rejects the request outright and returns an error naming the parameter it will not accept. Because the rejection happens before any work is done, there is no partial result, no default substituted for the rejected value, and no path by which a caller could mistake the outcome for success. The caller's own retry wrapper surfaced the error rather than swallowing it.
detection_path: The first run after the change failed loudly and stopped. No investigation was required to discover that something was wrong; the error text named the parameter.
consequence: Calls failed for the few hours between the change and the fix, which was to stop sending the parameter. Nothing was computed on a wrong basis in that window, because nothing was computed at all. No output produced during the window needed to be revisited.

symptom: A control that was supposed to re-derive an earlier selection of sixteen items could not be run at all: the sixteen were recorded only as a count, and the list of which items they were was never written down. Re-running the same selection procedure over the same unchanged data now yields two hundred and ninety-three, out of a base that has itself moved from ninety-eight to nine hundred and forty-four. Nothing in either number says why.
mechanism_as_described: The earlier result was a selection computed by the classifying machinery, and what was preserved from it was the size of the selection plus five member names quoted in passing. The machinery kept changing over the following four weeks. Because a count carries no record of the rules that produced it, the new count and the old count are not comparable and the difference cannot be attributed: from the two numbers alone, a selection growing from sixteen to two hundred and ninety-three is equally consistent with more data having arrived and with the selection rules having loosened, and here it is the second — the underlying data set is the same archived one throughout. A count over machine-computed selections is relative to the machine's state at the time, and the state was not recorded alongside it. What survived the drift is exactly the part that was written as identities rather than as a total: all five recorded names still select, and their individual computed values match to the digit. The lesson is stated in the close: save member lists, not population counts.
detection_path: An attempt to run a pre-planned control. The plan required the new selection to recover the earlier thirteen strict and three loose members; the attempt failed at the first step, because there was nothing to recover against. The audit then re-derived the selection on the same archived data at the current machine state, cross-witnessed the new base figure against an independent acceptance check recorded elsewhere at the same state, and compared against the current working data set as a third point — which is what established that the movement is in the machinery and not in the data. The control was recorded as retired-as-impossible rather than as passed, and the resulting ranking was relabelled as a current-state selection anchored by three named members rather than as a recovery of the earlier sixteen.
consequence: One planned control cannot be run, now or ever, for this result. The earlier finding survives only as the handful of members someone happened to name in prose, and any later reader comparing the two population figures without the machine state would read a nineteen-fold difference as a change in the data. The same exposure applies to every other result in the record that was preserved as a count over a computed selection.

symptom: A module was tracked as a second, older way of computing a central quantity, and the open question about it was framed as a choice between finishing its migration onto the current formula and declaring it a deliberate exception. Both framings assume it runs. It never ran, and had not for as long as the marker had been sitting on it.
mechanism_as_described: Three layers of unreachability stack, each of which individually looks like ordinary code. The module is loaded with an empty import list, so no unqualified call can resolve into it. Its single importer routes all five of its call sites through two lookup predicates. Both of those lookups are unconditional failure stubs — clauses whose bodies are just fail — over tables nothing in the live tree ever populates. The result is that every entry point is defined and failing rather than absent, which is the state that produces no signal at all: a caller gets a clean failure indistinguishable from a legitimate no-match, and the code reads as live in every static sense — it is loaded, it is imported, it has callers. Two genuine defects sat inside it undisturbed: a rule that binds one quantity to a variable named for a different one, against the written specification, and dropped one leg of that specification's condition; and a risk label carrying the wrong type index, naming a category that the specification assigns to something else entirely. Neither ever propagated, for the same reason nobody noticed the path was dead.
detection_path: The disposal work started by asking whether the path executes rather than which of the two proposed dispositions to take, and answered it with an exhaustive failure check over every corpus rather than a code read: three predicates across six data sets, each run with its own positive controls re-established per process, denominators matching the loader's own file counts exactly on all six. The load-bearing witness, though, is not that check — a check that enumerates facts structurally cannot see a call assembled at runtime. So the stubs were deleted, which turns those predicates from defined-and-failing into undefined; the argument that a hidden dynamic call would now raise an error instead of failing quietly was itself treated as a claim and witnessed, by running six goals under an error handler and confirming all six raise. Behaviour preservation was then witnessed on a run pair, with the note that a pipeline aborting on its own gates never rewrites its output, so a comparison taken afterwards would compare a file against itself and read identical — exit code and modification time were both confirmed before the comparison was trusted.
consequence: The question as posed had no correct answer: finishing the migration would have moved unreachable code onto the live path, and declaring an exception would have certified a path that never executes. Two defects that had lived in the code for its whole life were recorded rather than silently deleted with it. One capability really was lost — a detector with no equivalent anywhere else — so it was written up as a declared absence, with its own separate witness, before the deletion landed. And the disposal changed the failure mode of anything that might still reach that code from silent to loud, which is what makes a subsequent clean run informative rather than vacuous.

symptom: A measure run over one selected set of positions returned a large definite number — 45 under the frozen selection, 55 under a wider one — and that number was read as a property of the selected set. Run afterwards over the complement set and over the whole set, the measure returned densities of 0.4945, 0.60 and 0.4952: the selected set and the whole set agree to within 0.001, and in every set the raw number equals exactly the product of the counts of the two labels present.
mechanism_as_described: The positions being pooled have no identity across the documents they come from; each document assigns its own labels to its own positions. The six documents fall into two groups, and each group labels its positions with a single word — one word in one group, a different word in the other. The measure counts disagreeing pairs across the pooled set, so over a pooled vector containing exactly two distinct words it is the product of the two counts by arithmetic. Which positions were selected cannot change that shape, only the two counts. The number therefore reports the pooling convention and the group split, not anything about the property the selection was made to test. Nothing at the read site distinguishes the two: the measure emits an ordinary count in both cases, in range, with no marker that it was determined by the way the set was assembled. The exact product identity is what makes it visible — a value that cannot come out any other way — and it holds in all three sets, including the one the experiment was not about.
detection_path: Not by the experiment's own controls, which passed: a same-family comparator produced the contrary outcome, a single-document control produced zero, and a validity probe cleared both of its numeric criteria — all of which were read as showing the measure was not vacuous. It was found by a symmetric read requested in review after the experiment had closed: run the identical measure over the complement of the selected set and over every position, and compare. The three-way comparison is what exposed the identity; the two-way design could not have, because the contrary outcomes came from sets with no group split to inherit.
consequence: The experiment's headline cell was demoted after close. The scoped conclusion survives only at the altitude of what was actually operationalized; its weight against the idea it was built to test is minimal, because the construction could not have isolated that idea from the group structure. Had the complement never been run, a number that measures how a set was assembled would have entered the record as a substantive finding about the positions selected — and the controls that did run would have been cited as evidence it was not.

symptom: A topic carrying a genuine foundational disagreement was routed and processed as an ordinary topic with no such disagreement. The run completed, produced well-formed output of the expected shape, and gave no indication that a distinction had been dropped.
mechanism_as_described: The orchestrating pipeline's decomposition step used a prompt that never posed the question whose answer determines the routing. The classifier was capable of the distinction the whole time: putting the same topic to the same classifier with the question explicitly asked flips the verdict on three of three redraws. So the loss was in the calling path, not in the component that would have caught it. Because the unprimed path returns a valid decomposition either way, a dropped distinction and an absent distinction produce the same output, and the run cannot report a loss it never detected.
detection_path: A deliberate comparison: the same topics put to the same classifier twice, once through the production path and once with the question posed explicitly, and the two verdicts compared. Not a failure report from the pipeline, which had none to give.
consequence: For as long as the unprimed path was in use, topics admitting a foundational reading were flattened into ordinary ones without trace. The output shape is identical in both cases, so no downstream consumer could have distinguished them, and no count of runs would show it.

symptom: A summary table reported one item as unchanged under a perturbation — same number of cells before and after — while every cell in it had in fact been replaced. In the same summary, a conversion figure of nine out of ten concealed that the tenth was a pure loss with nothing gained in exchange, and a per-item view concealed that nine of the ten items had lost cells, making the effect substrate-wide rather than one fragile case.
mechanism_as_described: The reported observable is a count. The perturbation both destroys and creates cells, so an item whose composition turns over completely can net to zero and print as stable: in the witnessed row, three agreements and one disagreement became four agreements and none — the disagreement died and a new agreement appeared in a freshly split slot — and the count says nothing happened. The same arithmetic hides direction elsewhere: a conversion figure that fell by one reads like a small perturbation, when the set relationship is strict loss rather than substitution. And the count is not even monotone in the thing it is supposed to track: a coarsening move that can only increase alignment, by a stated theorem, reduced the cell count from 47 to 42, because merging vantages consolidates two cells into one. A statistic built on the count would therefore read a strict increase in alignment as a decrease in it — wrong in sign, not just in magnitude — and its fixed points are not fixed either.
detection_path: Not by the probe's own controls, which fired as designed: the perturbation was verified to have taken effect per arm and per corpus by comparing in-image fact counts against the arm file, the perturbed atom set was checked to be exactly the ten expected atoms, a known-changer case was verified to change, and the baseline arm's cell count was cross-checked at 47 against an independent instrument over the same substrate. The masking was found because a reviewer asked for the per-item rows behind the aggregates; the table was then built and the three facts fell out of it. The document also records a limit on one of the controls: a per-run line that prints a fact count cannot distinguish a perturbed arm from the baseline, because every arm maps the same number of items, so the discriminating controls are the atom-set assertion and the known-changer, not that line.
consequence: Three facts about the probe's own result were invisible in the form the result was first reported, and would have stayed invisible had the disaggregated table not been requested. The finding carried forward is a constraint on a statistic not yet built: it may not be a raw cell or vantage count, because such a count is non-monotone in the quantity of interest and its unchanged rows do not mean unchanged. Anything downstream that aggregates these verdicts across differently-partitioned inputs needs the partition stamped alongside, since the verdicts are not stable across partitions.

symptom: The assistant stopped answering entirely for 13 hours, replying to every incoming message with content the gateway then stripped to nothing.
mechanism_as_described: The assistant's file-write tool wrote a 'task complete' line into a reserved control file. Writing to that file activates a mechanism that makes the assistant answer all incoming messages with a fixed acknowledgement token, and the gateway strips that token before delivery. The assistant had write permission on the file that governs whether it can speak at all, so a routine write disabled it.
detection_path: A person noticed the absence of replies.
consequence: 13 hours of total silence, presenting to the user as the assistant simply not replying. Reported silent interval: 13h.

symptom: A measurement arm reported results over 57 items where the working set held 64. The run completed normally, every gate passed, and the per-item outputs were correct for the 57 it saw. Only the count disagreed with the expected count.
mechanism_as_described: The probe ran from an isolated checkout created off the committed tree. Seven items existed only as uncommitted files, so the isolated checkout did not contain them and the enumeration returned 57. Nothing in the path could report the difference: the enumerator faithfully lists what exists where it looks, and 57 items each processed correctly is a well-formed result. The gates were all written to check the quality of what was measured, not whether the substrate was the intended one, so the substrate divergence passed through every one of them.
detection_path: Comparing the arm's item count against the working set's count and refusing to treat the difference as noise — then identifying the missing seven by name and confirming they were exactly the uncommitted ones, rather than assuming a processing drop.
consequence: One arm of a three-arm comparison measured a different population than intended. Here the consequence was bounded and was reported: the seven would not have moved a verdict on which all three arms already agreed in sign. The mechanism is not bounded — the same divergence in a run whose result depended on the missing items would have produced a confident answer about the wrong population.

symptom: One stage of the classifier declines to apply a signature to an item at particular observer positions, having routed that position elsewhere. A later stage applies a multiplicative boost derived from the same signature at every position regardless, including the ones the earlier stage declined. The result is a recorded probability distribution that assigns mass to a category the item had already been routed away from — with no error, and with the headline category unchanged at every position, so nothing in the ordinary output shows the two stages disagreeing.
mechanism_as_described: The routing decision is per position; the boost is per item. The boost predicate was written with no access to the position at all — it received the item's winning signature and nothing else — so it could not have consulted the routing even in principle, and its unconditional application looked correct at the site because the site had no second argument to check. The distortion then stayed invisible for a specific reason: at all twelve affected positions the boosted distribution's highest-probability category was already the same as the unboosted one, so the headline reading never moved. What moved was the distribution's mass, and a second serialization of the same computation whose highest-probability category was taken after the boost — there the boost had lifted the target category above the true winner at one position, producing a recorded category that was the boost's product rather than the data's. Downstream, the item's headline verdict is a join that takes its severity from other inputs, so even the flipped category changed no verdict — the defect was verdict-capable but happened to be benign on that position, which is why nothing raised it.
detection_path: Threading the item identifier into the boost predicate so the question 'was this position routed away?' could be asked at all, then comparing the post-boost distribution against the pre-boost one at every position on both serializations, rather than comparing only the highest-probability category. The check was run with both halves stated in advance: the twelve routed positions must move and the eighty non-routed ones must not, with a rule fixed beforehand for what a non-routed move would mean. It was paired with a control establishing the comparison could see movement at all — a corpus-wide count found exactly two positions whose recorded category differed from the unboosted one, both from a different, unconditional boost, confirming the comparison was capable of returning a difference where one existed.
consequence: For every position the earlier stage had routed away from a signature, the recorded distribution still carried mass attributed to that signature's target category, and a rendered per-item report displayed it as an ordinary probability — in one case a category shown at 0.068 that should have been 0.000. On the serialization whose category was read after the boost, one item's recorded category was manufactured outright. Because the highest-probability category on the primary path never flipped, no consumer of that path could distinguish a boosted distribution from an unboosted one, and the disagreement between the two stages was reported nowhere.

symptom: A generated report concluded that a group of items showed 'coordinated rather than independent operation' — a claim about the actors the items describe. The items did agree, and every step that produced the conclusion ran correctly. The agreement had two causes, both internal to the system: the items were separate slices of one authored situation and therefore shared their named parties, and the uniform verdict they agreed on was fixed by a single configuration constant rather than measured per item. The report distinguished neither, because nothing it reads carries the distinction.
mechanism_as_described: Two mechanisms compose. First, the relation graph links two items whenever they name a party in common, and it has no notion of whether the two items are independent observations at all — a group of co-authored slices of one situation forms exactly the same shape as a group of genuinely distinct items, and is indistinguishable in kind from it. The step that merges duplicate links between the same pair keeps one label, so the fact that a pair shares BOTH a benefiting party AND a harmed party — the very thing that would mark them as one situation described twice — is not expressible at the level where the links live. Second, the per-item verdict that the group agrees on is not continuous: one authored role choice supplies a fixed number, and that number and its nearest alternative fall on opposite sides of the threshold where the verdict changes sign, so the verdict is a restatement of a discrete authoring decision. Because agreement produced by re-description and agreement produced by convergence look identical downstream, a step that counts agreement across links reports the first as the second.
detection_path: Two independent checks, both with their negative half constructed in advance. A fixture pair: three items written as slices of one situation (same benefiting party, same harmed party, near-identical magnitude) and three genuinely distinct items. The first formed the complete set of links; the second formed none — and it is the second that matters, because it establishes the empty result is the filter working rather than a probe that cannot return anything. Separately, a census over the live output computed for every item whether its authored role value and the nearest alternative role value sit on opposite sides of the sign threshold, using the parameter values as serialized in that same output rather than a copy: 103 of 105 items qualified, 98.1%. Items whose value matched no role constant were counted and surfaced as their own bucket rather than quietly dropped, so the rate could not be read as a share of everything.
consequence: For as long as the read stood, sets of items that were one authored situation described several times were reported as mutually corroborating, and a shared configuration constant was reported as coordinated behaviour by the parties described. The failure mode is specifically hard to see from the output: corroboration and re-description produce the same tallies, the same links, and the same confident sentence, and the sentence names something in the world rather than something about the data. A reader has no way to ask which one they are looking at.

symptom: A data-completeness verification stage prints 'Verification passed' and a per-item validation stage prints no failures, for an item whose entire measurement grid is unfilled — 32 of 32 slots absent and zero per-item checks executed. Both stages emit exactly the success line they emit when they have checked something and found it sound.
mechanism_as_described: Two independent sites produce a success that reports on nothing. (a) A repair stage runs before verification and fills every absent grid slot, either with a fixed mid-scale default value or with a value imputed from priors. Verification then tests the grid for completeness — but its input has been made complete by the stage immediately upstream, so the test cannot come out any other way. Its pass reports the repair, not the data. The report now states this in the pass line itself: completeness is guaranteed by the repair stage, and the check is non-discriminating after it. (b) The per-item validation iterates over the item's authored classifications and checks each one; with none authored the iteration body never runs and the enclosing check succeeds having run zero checks. Downstream of both, a structural-pattern verdict was computed over the grid, so a verdict could rest on values that were generated by the repair rather than authored, with nothing at the read site marking which slots were which. The described remedy has three parts: the filling was retired so an absent slot now stays open; each stage prints a provenance split of the grid (authored / filled-at-default / imputed-from-priors / absent) so the origin of every value travels with it; and the pattern verdict now abstains with a named reason instead of returning a value computed over unfilled ground.
detection_path: Visible in the report text only after the filling was disabled and each stage was made to print its own input provenance. With the fill off, the same verification stage still printed a pass over a grid of 32 absent slots, and the same per-item stage still printed no failures over zero executed checks — which is what shows neither stage had ever been discriminating. The annotations naming the verification non-discriminating and the zero-check result 'not a clean pass' were added at that point and appear in every one of the five reports snapshotted here.
consequence: For as long as the filling was live, a verification of data completeness and a per-item validation both reported success over values the system had generated for itself, and those values were indistinguishable at every downstream read from values an author supplied. The affected reads carry a success line whose real meaning is 'nothing was examined' rather than 'what was examined was sound' — and the two are the same string. The residue is still visible in the snapshot: the item is fully unmeasured, and both stages still print success, now qualified.

symptom: A system-level gradient metric read exactly 0.0 on every input it had ever been given, including inputs deliberately constructed to produce a large non-zero value. The verdict derived from it was correspondingly always the same one. Nothing errored, and the value was plausible: 0.0 is what a genuinely flat input should produce.
mechanism_as_described: A helper that enumerates time points ended with a cut annotated as an optimization, which made it return only its first solution instead of enumerating. Its single caller used a set-builder to collect points later than a given time; with only the first point ever offered, no later point was ever found, so every gradient computation failed. The aggregating caller mapped the resulting empty collection to 0.0 as a fallback. A failed computation and a measured-flat series therefore produced the identical value at every read site, for the entire life of the construct. Two conditions were needed and both held: the enumerator silently became single-solution, and the aggregate had a plausible value to emit when it got nothing.
detection_path: A pre-registered probe with five hand-authored inputs whose correct outputs were computed in advance, including non-flat ones. The break localized because a sibling metric read its authored data correctly on the very same runs while this one returned 0.0 — the disagreement between two metrics over one input was the signal, not any error.
consequence: Every gradient the construct ever computed had failed, and the failure was indistinguishable from a real measurement of flatness at every consumer. A control input authored to be genuinely flat could not be distinguished from total blindness until the enumerator was repaired. After repair the five inputs reproduce their pre-computed values exactly.

symptom: A single idiom — one that converts a missing input into a plausible successful value — was found at many independent sites across the engine. An instance of it had already been found and repaired months earlier as OQ-93 (`system_gradient`'s `[] -> 0.0`); the repair had been applied at the site where it was found, and the same shape at the other sites had never been looked for. The OQ-97 close-out is titled for what it censuses: a Pattern-6 success-shaped-absorption census over all top-level `prolog/*.pl`.
mechanism_as_described: The idiom takes several surface forms, and the census sorts them into three greppable shapes: a numeric default in an else-branch (Shape A, 160 raw lines across 38 files), a findall/setof/aggregate_all whose empty collection is folded to a value (Shape B, 227), and a constant atom default (Shape C, 210). Triaged into 19 classes, the confirmed candidates are: a statistic computed over an empty collection returning 0.0 (class A2 — the `system_gradient` twin, breadth); absence certifying cleanliness, where `CC = 1.0 % No coupling = clean` and `EX = 1.0 % No extraction data = clean` at `purity_scoring.pl:80/:88` make a missing datum pass the clean gate (class A6, the OQ-43 semantics); a caught error collapsing to zero mass (class A10, `json_report.pl:415-418`, where the catch arm AND the failure arm both emit 0.0); and a probe whose silence is read as agreement, feeding the OQ-98 verdict join as absence-of-alert one level below a banner that had itself already been repaired (class C4a) — so the repaired surface sits on top of an unrepaired input. Each form is locally defensible and none raises an error, so no check at any individual site can detect the class; the defect is visible only in the distribution, which nothing was measuring. The sound classes are sound for a stateable reason and the source states it: a findall over a directly-defined rule IS the look, so an empty result is measured-empty (class B1, the large majority of the 227 Shape-B rows), and `maplist(force_obstruction, Constraints)` preceding the `cached_obstruction` aggregation excludes didn't-look by construction (class A8). Where that reason is unavailable the class stays a candidate: an untyped node contributing no contamination may be intended semantics, but the aggregate cannot distinguish it from didn't-look (class A7).
detection_path: A bounded grep for the SHAPE rather than for any symptom, with denominators recorded at execution (`ls prolog/*.pl | wc -l` -> 106 files, a superset of `stack.pl`'s 47 load directives) and positive controls proving the search could retrieve instances already known to exist — two controls fired for Shape A, two for Shape B, three for Shape C. The controls did real work rather than decorating the method: two Shape-C grep iterations were REJECTED by the pinned controls before the final pattern, because a bare-atom version missed the compound-term default `pass(no_extraction_data)` and a no-comment-tolerance version missed defaults followed by a trailing `%` comment; Shape A was then regenerated with the same comment tolerance, 149 -> 160 lines. The controls matter because the search's output is a list, and an empty or short list is otherwise indistinguishable from a clean system. The census also witnesses a prior repair: `drl_core.pl` returns zero Shape-A hits because OQ-44 commit C removed its `Value = 0` default, and the grep that fires 160 times elsewhere returns nothing in it.
consequence: Multiple sites were carrying verdict-grade and diagnostic-grade outputs computed on absent inputs; the candidate classes were filed as OQ-112 under a file-don't-fix policy, with no engine `.pl` modified (`git diff --stat` witnessed at commit — ISSUES.md, KNOWN_STATE.md and audits/ only). None of the candidates sits on the `dr_type` classification path, which was the pre-registered halt condition and was checked. The search's own limits were declared rather than discovered, which is the Pattern-6 discipline applied to the census itself — the bound is declared, not silent: a fixed 3-line proximity window that cannot see the split form of the idiom (a findall whose list is summed in a different predicate), class verdicts generalised from one to three read witnesses per idiom, and a denominator scoped to statically declared load directives, which does not cover a runtime `consult/1` with a computed path.
