symptom: A standing claim in the issue tracker held that the process records why it chose each answer but never why it chose each question. The rationale for the question choice turned out to be recorded, and recorded thoroughly — 2596 of 2598 choices carry an authored reason, every one of 1022 deferrals carries a reason, and a further verdict is present on 486 of 515 records. None of it was reachable from any place that would read it, so at every such place the rich record and no record at all looked identical.
mechanism_as_described: The rationale lives in files written to a directory excluded from version control — zero of them tracked — so a fresh copy of the repository contains none of it. The files carry no stamp of their own origin: no record of which model, prompt, or schema produced them, and no timestamp of their own. And there is no link from the items they explain back to them: the field on each item that would carry the producing run's identifier holds the literal string for absent in all 71 live emissions, and the one variable in the orchestration code that holds the path of the file just written is assigned in two places and read in none. Nothing consumes the deferral list at all except two audit probes, one of them an archived copy. Each of the three gaps is individually mild — an untracked output directory, an unstamped file, an unpopulated optional field — and together they make the record unaddressable, so a reader at any downstream point sees the same thing whether the rationale was never written or is sitting on a machine they do not have. What was actually wrong was therefore the opposite of the standing claim: not that the choice went undeclared, but that its declaration could not be gotten to.
detection_path: A recon that treated an earlier agent's summary as hypothesis and re-witnessed every load-bearing claim with pasted output and a positive control beside it: a census script written for this audit rather than reusing the earlier counts, a tracked-and-non-empty sibling directory as the control for the untracked one, an exhaustive rather than sampled classification of both shortfall strata, and a planted two-sided fixture proving the classifier could emit the other verdict — which is what makes the zero in that stratum a measured zero rather than a branch that never fires. The re-witnessing changed several of the earlier numbers, and the writeup states which figures supersede which.
consequence: A characterization of the system's own discipline had stood in the tracker and was false as written; it was corrected explicitly rather than quietly amended. The fix is a join identifier minted at choice time and threaded through all three write paths — the third of which was found only while implementing — plus a self-stamp on each file, a tracked location, and a standing readout with a four-way token that names which of the failure states obtains. The readout is declared wired but not yet joined: all 205 live items still report no identifier authored, and the joined state is exercised only by a planted control, so the fix graduates on the next real run rather than now.

symptom: The schema field `base_properties.mandatrophy_resolved` (boolean) is declared, and the engine predicates written to consume it — `has_mandatrophy_declaration/1` and `is_mandatrophy_resolved/1` — both exist and load without error. The condition they express has never been true for any story in the working corpus. Nothing reports this. Every consumer reads the failing predicate as 'this constraint does not have the property', which is indistinguishable from 'no constraint can ever have it'. Found in section A7 of the OQ-83 step-4 stakeholder-layer migration feasibility audit, while mapping the apparatus available to R5.
mechanism_as_described: The schema declares `base_properties.mandatrophy_resolved`, but the compiler that converts authored JSON records into engine facts emits NO clause for it: `grep -c "attribute(" generate_constraint_pl.py` returns 0 across the entire generator. The field's prose sibling IS emitted — `commentary.mandatrophy_analysis`, at `generate_constraint_pl.py:624-646` — so an author who fills the field in sees their text appear in the compiled `.pl` and receives no signal that the structured half went nowhere. The single live-corpus grep hit for the term is that commentary prose, `challenge_as_commons_maintenance.pl:193`, not a fact. On the read side there are two consumers: `has_mandatrophy_declaration/1` (`narrative_ontology.pl:117-121`) tests for `attribute(C, lifecycle, mandatrophy)`, a fact the compiler never writes and of which the live corpus holds zero; `is_mandatrophy_resolved/1` (`narrative_ontology.pl:389-390`) is satisfied only by two facts hardcoded in the engine source itself, `gale_shapley` and `planetary_boundaries`, both naming stories from an archived corpus and neither present in the live one. Each end is individually well-formed — a valid schema entry, correct consumer code — and the break is the missing segment between them, which no single-file read exposes because neither file is wrong. The computed side of the same concept is alive throughout: piton dead-coordination via `classify_from_metrics` (`drl_core.pl:300-323`) and `detect_omega(_, mandatrophy)` (`narrative_ontology.pl:393-401`). The audit's verdict names the shape directly: the existing mandatrophy authoring surface is a Build-Discipline Pattern-1 dangling wire, and the prescription is One canonical thing (Pattern 2) — extend, don't fork — rewiring R5's genealogy field and mismatch consumer into it rather than adding a third surface.
detection_path: Counting rather than reading: how many clauses the compiler emits for the field (`grep -c "attribute(" generate_constraint_pl.py` = 0), and how many facts of the consumed predicate exist on the live corpus (0). The counts were paired with a positive control — the same greps were run for the engine-side definitions in `narrative_ontology.pl` and DID return hits — establishing that the searches were capable of finding what they now reported missing, so the zeroes describe the corpus and not the search.
consequence: A capability the schema advertises has never once been exercised, and nothing downstream can distinguish that from stories legitimately lacking the property. Any check written over `mandatrophy_resolved` passes or fails on no data while appearing to test the stories, and a reader of the schema would reasonably assume the feature works. The condition persisted long enough that the only two facts satisfying the live consumer are hand-written examples naming archived stories no longer in use. The audit routes the repair as a rewire of the dangling surface rather than a third one: the A4 `ritual_operator` residue (~23 mentions) is the witnessed authoring-side population it should have been reading, with the computed piton/theater path as its cross-check.

symptom: A thinking-parity re-run of the five-leg twin comparison ran two conditions of `kimi-k2.6`, labelled heavy and 'reduced', to close the battery's regime confound — whether kimi's stance sharpness is just its reasoning tokens. The reduced condition consumed MORE reasoning than the heavy one: 4617 against 3864 on probe P2 (memetic_mirror), 4942 against 3955 on probe P3 (perspective_diff). The flag `enable_thinking:false`, which was supposed to disable the reasoning, was accepted without complaint and did nothing.
mechanism_as_described: The request carries `enable_thinking:false`. The service accepts it and returns normally; nothing in the response says the setting was ignored. The one observable that would show it — `thoughtsTokenCount`, the count of reasoning tokens actually consumed — sits in the response metadata and is not part of the result the experiment reads, so an arm can be labelled 'reduced' on the strength of the request rather than of the behaviour. Belief that the flag worked came from a single earlier one-shot probe where the count fell from 972 to 292; kimi's reasoning volume varies widely between draws at roughly 4-5k tokens, so one before-and-after pair is not distinguishable from noise, and the drop was read as the flag taking effect. The consequence propagates quietly: two conditions meant to differ on the manipulated variable are in fact two independent heavy-reasoning draws of the same condition, and any contrast between them measures draw-to-draw variation while carrying the name of the manipulation. The parallel arm on `gemini-2.5-flash`, where the same kind of setting DID take effect, produced a clean contrast — 0 / 0 tokens under think_off against 2782 / 1229 under think_max — which is what made the failure visible by comparison rather than in isolation.
detection_path: The write-up opens with a table headed 'What actually varied (honest instrumentation note)': intended condition against the measured `thoughtsTokenCount`, per probe, per model. Filling that table is what exposed it — the gemini row confirms the instrument reads the quantity correctly and that a working setting shows up as a zero, so kimi's rising counts cannot be dismissed as a reporting artifact. The earlier 972 -> 292 probe was then re-read as a draw from a noisy distribution rather than as a manipulation check. Raw data: `battery/parity_responses.json`.
consequence: The arm the parity test was built around did not exist. Reported honestly, its verdict is carried entirely by the within-gemini reasoning contrast plus a kimi replication across two same-condition heavy draws, and the specific question the arm was designed to answer — whether kimi stays sharp when its reasoning is suppressed — is recorded as not tested. Had the counts not been tabulated, the study would have reported a manipulation that never happened and attributed a null result to it; the two kimi conditions would have differed slightly, as independent draws do, and the difference would have been read as an effect of the variable that never moved. What the surviving arms do establish is a negative about the other model: gemini's stance thinness is intrinsic rather than a reasoning deficit, since max reasoning made it a more organized Disciple rather than a Critic and returned the same five stock seats on the perspective-diff probe.

symptom: An experiment ran two conditions of one generator, labelled heavy and reduced, to test whether the amount of internal reasoning explains a difference in output quality. The reduced condition consumed more internal reasoning than the heavy one — 4617 against 3864 on one probe, 4942 against 3955 on the other. The flag that was supposed to disable the reasoning was accepted without complaint and did nothing.
mechanism_as_described: The request carries a boolean asking the generator not to reason. The service accepts the request and returns normally; nothing in the response says the setting was ignored. The one observable that would show it — the count of reasoning units actually consumed — sits in the response metadata and is not part of the result the experiment reads, so an arm can be labelled reduced on the strength of the request rather than of the behaviour. Belief that the flag worked came from a single earlier probe where the count fell from 972 to 292; that generator's reasoning volume varies widely between draws, so one before-and-after pair is not distinguishable from noise, and the drop was read as the flag taking effect. The consequence propagates quietly: two conditions that were meant to differ on the manipulated variable are in fact two independent draws of the same condition, and any contrast between them measures draw-to-draw variation while carrying the name of the manipulation. The parallel arm on a second generator, where the same kind of setting did take effect, produced a clean contrast — 0 units against roughly one to three thousand — which is what made the failure visible by comparison rather than in isolation.
detection_path: The write-up opens with a table of what actually varied: intended condition against the measured count of reasoning units consumed, per probe, per generator. Filling that table is what exposed it — the second generator's row confirms the instrument reads the quantity correctly and that a working setting shows up as a zero, so the first generator's rising counts cannot be dismissed as a reporting artifact. The earlier single probe was then re-read as a draw from a noisy distribution rather than as a manipulation check.
consequence: The arm the experiment was built around did not exist. Reported honestly, its verdict is carried entirely by the other generator's arm plus a replication across two same-condition draws, and the specific question the arm was designed to answer — whether that generator stays sharp when its reasoning is suppressed — is recorded as not tested. Had the counts not been tabulated, the study would have reported a manipulation that never happened and attributed a null result to it; the two conditions would have differed slightly, as independent draws do, and the difference would have been read as an effect of the variable that never moved.

symptom: An organisation published its annual report two weeks after the date it had announced. The delay was known internally three weeks in advance, was communicated to the board when it became known, and was announced publicly before the original date passed.
mechanism_as_described: The report cannot be published until an external reviewer signs off on one section. The reviewer's own schedule slipped because a prior engagement over-ran. Each party knew the true state of the schedule at every point: the reviewer told the organisation when the slip became likely, the organisation told its board the same week, and the published date moved once and then held. No step reported completion it had not reached, no missing input was treated as a present one, and at no time did any party hold a belief about the schedule that the evidence available to them contradicted.
detection_path: Nothing had to be detected. The delay was reported by the party causing it, before it happened, through the channel that exists for reporting it.
consequence: The report appeared two weeks late. Readers waited two weeks. No decision was taken on the basis of a document that did not yet exist, and no version of the report circulated in the interim.

symptom: A feature was believed to reproduce when the same source material was regenerated: an in-session read of the two regenerations put the reproduction rate at one to two out of two. Adjudicated blind against the same rubric, the rate is zero out of two. The regenerations do carry something that looks like the feature — same topic, same shape, a near-identical name — and it fails the definition's second clause both times.
mechanism_as_described: The feature is defined as a conjunction of two clauses. Each regeneration produced an item satisfying the first clause and satisfying something in the neighbourhood of the second: one failed on a coverage clause, the other on a structure-import clause, where the definition requires a fidelity clause. A reader who already knows which output is the original, and who is looking for a feature they expect to find, scores those neighbouring clauses as satisfied — the item is recognisably the same kind of thing, and the difference lives one level down in which clause of the conjunction it satisfies. The names reinforce the error from the other side: the regenerations name their item almost as the original does, so a name-level check reports a match while the defined conjunction fails. The divergence between the two ways of reading is one-directional, and this is the second time in the same programme that it has run that way: the read that knows the answer credits more stability than the blinded measurement supports.
detection_path: A blinded adjudication designed in advance for exactly this comparison. All fourteen candidate items across the original and both regenerations were pooled into one packet with the labels stripped; the packet's checksum and the withheld label-to-item mapping's checksum were both pinned in a design document frozen before any scoring; a fresh adjudicator with no access to the repository or to which item came from where scored every item against the rubric; the calls were committed before the mapping file entered the tree; then the mapping was revealed and its checksum verified against the pin. The unblinded reading had been filed in advance, explicitly as a hypothesis rather than a measurement, so that the size and direction of any divergence would be recorded rather than reconstructed.
consequence: Without the blinded arm, a claim of one-to-two-out-of-two stability would have been published for a form whose measured stability at its own source is zero out of two, and a downstream verification stage would have been run to test a feature already known to be unstable — an estimated quarter of a million tokens spent filling a row the design's own interpretation table would have rendered unreadable. The result also fires a pre-registered disclosure that must be carried into every later reading of this feature. The general residue is stated plainly: a reading that knows the answer over-credits stability, in one consistent direction, twice now.

symptom: An authoring field defined in the item specification, and the engine predicates written to consume it, both exist and load without error. The condition they express has never been true for any item in the working corpus. Nothing reports this. Every consumer reads the failing predicate as "this item does not have the property," which is indistinguishable from "no item can ever have it."
mechanism_as_described: The specification declares the field, but the compiler that converts authored records into engine facts emits no clause for it at all — zero emissions across the entire generator. The field's prose sibling IS emitted, as a comment, so an author who fills the field in sees their text appear in the compiled output and receives no signal that the structured half went nowhere. On the read side there are two consumers: one tests for a fact the compiler never writes, of which the working corpus holds none; the other is satisfied only by two facts hardcoded in the engine source itself, both naming items from an archived corpus and neither present in the working one. Each end is individually well-formed — a valid specification entry, correct consumer code — and the break is the missing segment between them, which no single-file read exposes because neither file is wrong.
detection_path: Counting rather than reading: how many clauses the compiler emits for the field (zero), and how many facts of the consumed predicate exist on the working corpus (zero). The counts were paired with a control — the same searches were run for the engine-side definitions and did return hits — establishing that the searches were capable of finding what they now reported missing, so the zeroes describe the corpus and not the search.
consequence: A capability the specification advertises has never once been exercised, and nothing downstream can distinguish that from items legitimately lacking the property. Any check written over the field passes or fails on no data while appearing to test the items, and a reader of the specification would reasonably assume the feature works. The condition persisted long enough that the only two facts satisfying the live consumer are hand-written examples naming items no longer in use.

symptom: One field of a three-field comparison turned out to be unanswerable, and not for lack of data: the stored values are there, complete, with no gaps and no out-of-range entries. The problem is that a value an author supplied and a value the tooling substituted for a rejected one are the same bytes in the same slot, and no surviving artifact says which is which.
mechanism_as_described: A repair step sits between generation and storage. It holds a fixed map from two rejected values onto one accepted value, applies it, and returns with no logging at all along that path — the most likely substitution leaves no trace by construction. Four channels that could each have carried the distinction are each silent for a different reason. The generator writes no raw output: the batch result is consumed in memory and discarded after repair, and its only file write is the list of items still unprocessed. The repair step's own statistics are aggregate — a global count and a flat list of substituted values, with no per-item key — and, as it turned out, no committed file anywhere contains that counter at all. The parallel serialization written alongside the stored facts is produced after repair from the same object, so its distribution matches the stored facts exactly, including zero missing and zero out-of-range, and cannot reveal what was there before. And the accepted-value distribution, seen after the fact, looks like clean authored data precisely because the substitution normalized it. The one thing that saved the headline was a different property, established by reading the code rather than the artifacts: the other accepted value cannot be produced or removed by any substitution path, and an absent value fails generation outright instead of quietly defaulting — so the headline asymmetry between the two sources is real, and only the fine interpretation of the substituted side is lost.
detection_path: A gate run before the comparison began, asking not whether the field's numbers reproduce but whether the distinction the planned decision rule depends on could be recovered at all from anything on disk. The check went channel by channel — generator artifacts, repair statistics, the substitution path's own logging, the parallel serialization — and included a search of every committed file for the repair counter's name, which came back empty. Because the answer was negative, the field was declared out of scope for the pass rather than answered with a weaker substitute, and the recovery cost was stated exactly: regenerating that corpus with instrumentation added.
consequence: A pre-registered decision clause for that field can never be evaluated on existing data; answering it requires paying the generation cost again, which had already been ruled out. Everything downstream that reads those values reads a mixture of authored and substituted entries with no way to separate them, and the mixture presents as a clean, fully-populated field with no invalid entries — the substitution's success is what makes it invisible. The graduation step is recorded: log the per-item identifier at the substitution site in the next generation run, then re-run the decision rule.

symptom: A rendered report stated that a set of items showed 'coordinated rather than independent operation.' Neither half of that reading survives inspection: the uniformity it rests on comes from a shared configuration constant rather than from the items, and the links that made the set look mutually corroborating connect co-authored slices of a single underlying fact.
mechanism_as_described: Two independent mechanisms arrive at the same read site. First, the position a given seat is assigned depends on an authored role label, and each role label maps to a fixed numeric constant. Two of the five constants, 0.12 and 0.25, sit on opposite sides of the sign root of the curve the verdict is computed from — the root falls at about 0.164 — and they are each other's nearest alternative. So a seat whose author picked either of those two roles has a verdict that flips outright if the author had picked the other. In the live data 101 of the seats carry one of them and 2 carry the other: 103 of 105 comparable seats, 98%, are in this state. Uniformity across such items therefore reports which role most authors reached for, not anything measured about the situations. Second, the link structure feeding the same read joins any two items that share a beneficiary or share a victim, and has no notion of node independence at all — three slices of one fact form a complete triangle that is indistinguishable in kind from a triangle of genuinely distinct items. A deduplication step compounds this by collapsing a pair's two links into one label, so 'these two share both sides' cannot even be expressed at that layer. The read site above them then treats the triangle as three corroborating observations, when it is one observation described three times.
detection_path: Criteria fixed and committed before any run, with each outcome's meaning written down in advance. For the link structure, a synthetic fixture of six items: three co-authored slices of one fact with matched parties and near-identical magnitudes, and three pairwise-distinct extractive items. The first three formed the complete triangle and the second three formed no links at all — which makes the first group the positive control for the second, so the empty lists are a filter result rather than a probe that never ran. The fixture's magnitudes were chosen to sit safely inside the margin rather than on it, because a value on the boundary would have passed on rounding alone. For the seat verdicts, a census over the live output computed the sign root from the serialized parameters of that same output rather than from a copied constant, pasted all five role constants because the nearest-alternative claim depends on every one of them, and reported every bucket separately — including the seats whose value matches no role constant and the seats with no value at all, which shrink the denominator and are counted rather than quietly dropped.
consequence: A published report asserted coordination among items where the shared property was a configuration constant. The repair is at the read sites rather than the constants: an independence column and a legend that names a link between items sharing both a beneficiary and a victim at near-identical magnitude as re-description rather than corroboration; a mark on any seat verdict that flips under a single authored role change; and a replacement for the coordination sentence that names both alternative explanations. One pre-registered detail was extended during implementation rather than followed literally: the census turned up a firing of the same predicate at a seat the design had not scoped, and suppressing it would have unflagged a witnessed firing, so the flag is computed per seat.

symptom: Stories whose `claimed_type` was `mountain` — contradicted by several independent structural checks — nonetheless summarized as yellow. The contradicting checks (dirac, cohomology, maxent, context_gap) had all run and all disagreed; each disagreement was then recorded as an expected_conflict, so the summary showed one unresolved abductive tension where there were four. Nothing in the output indicated that classifying those disagreements as expected was itself a consequence of a correction the same system had applied moments earlier. This is the OQ-138 `false_summit_mountain` clause of the FSM `resolve_modal_signature_conflict`.
mechanism_as_described: The FSM overwrote the story's computed `dr_type` with `tangled_rope`. Separately, `diagnostic_summary` suppresses divergences known to be normal for the type the story holds — a sensible rule, since some subsystems characteristically disagree with certain types. But the type they were tested against was the overwritten one. The override had moved the story into precisely the type in which a structural second-classness (Dirac) and a descent failure ARE normal, so the disagreements arrived pre-explained via the override-keyed `signature_override_artifact` and `pre_post_override_divergence` patterns plus `constructed_type(tangled_rope)`, and were filed rather than raised. Remove the override — flip `config.pl:488` `false_summit_override_target` from `tangled_rope` to `mountain`, so the mountain-input clause head binds `Result = Target = ModalType` and no overwrite occurs, while the unknown-input clause returns `unknown` on the OQ-37 honest-abstain precedent with zero live fires — and the original type returns; the same unchanged disagreements are then abnormal for it and surface as genuine. `verdict_join` moves from yellow to red with no measurement changed and no change to `claimed_type`. The suppression rule was never about the evidence — it was keyed to a type the system had assigned to itself.
detection_path: Running the full pipeline before and after removing the override over an identical corpus (`PIPELINE_OLD.txt` vs `PIPELINE_NEW.txt`, all 92 live seats), and requiring every unaffected seat to come out byte-identical — 89 of 92 were, across claimed_type, signature, verdict_join, base and grade, which isolated the three affected seats and made the change in their verdicts attributable to the override and nothing else. The decisive step was that the change ran contrary to what had been written down in advance: the plan predicted the verdict would go GREEN and it went RED, and the discrepancy was investigated instead of accepted. Generality was then established with `twin_sweep.pl` on `testsets_flash` (overlay-took-effect witnessed: 960 loaded), reproducing the earlier breadth result exactly at 40 FSM fires = 18 vic=0 + 22 vic>0 on the same 22 named seats, and across five corpora totalling roughly six thousand stories all 82 affected seats carried the same structural disagreements — so the three were not special.
consequence: For as long as the override was in place, stories whose `claimed_type=mountain` was structurally contradicted reported the contradiction as expected and summarized yellow. The concealment is self-reinforcing: the more decisively the override moves a story, the more completely the evidence against it is classified as normal. From any output, a genuinely mild case and a suppressed severe one are indistinguishable — the same verdict colour, the same conflicts listed as expected. The converted behaviour makes those seats report red, which reads as a regression and is the opposite: it is what the override had been hiding. Two of the three drop from grade=correction to grade=commentary under victim-discriminated severity, and `maxent_top_type=mountain` now AGREES with the reverted type.

symptom: A named quantity is reported as one of a small set of words — sound, borderline, degraded — and the same word denotes a different numeric range depending on which module produced it. Three modules each define a predicate of the identical name and arity, none of them calls or imports another, and nothing in an emitted value records which one produced it.
mechanism_as_described: One concept, three self-contained definitions of the same predicate name, and no authoritative one. The first bands a score into five names at cut points 0.90 / 0.70 / 0.50 / 0.30; the second bands into four different names at 0.70 / 0.50 / 0.30; the third bands into four further names at floors read from configuration rather than hardcoded. No two of the three share a complete set of names, so the sets are not interchangeable — and worse than plain disagreement, they partially overlap: one word appears in two of the three but at different positions in the ordering (third band of five in one, second band of four in the other), so the same word denotes two different score ranges. A second word appears in all three with the same intended meaning but a different cut point behind it in each. A fourth site describes three bands in a header comment at yet another set of cut points, with no predicate at all, so a reader looking for the definition can land on a description that governs nothing. The audit also records a near neighbour that must not be folded in: a differently-named predicate in a fifth module returns an atom that collides with one of the band words but is a different quantity entirely, so counting it as a fourth definition would compound the error rather than complete the inventory.
detection_path: A scoped code-versus-documentation reconnaissance that enumerated, for each concept the documentation names, every predicate implementing it, and classified the result as unified (one definition, others import), convergent (several, same output), or divergent (several, different output). The verdict criteria were fixed before the enumeration ran, and this concept was carried forward from an earlier reconnaissance that had flagged the same three-implementation state, so the finding is a confirmation on re-examination rather than a first sighting.
consequence: A band word read anywhere downstream cannot be interpreted without knowing which module emitted it, and the value does not carry that. Two of the three vocabularies can produce the same word for scores that the other would band differently, so a comparison across modules, or any consolidation onto a single name, would keep computing bands and get them wrong by one cut point without any read failing. The state had already been reported once and persisted to this second examination unchanged.

symptom: A census reports two absence categories — this item has no measurable founding condition, this item has no party occupying a position — over 26 items each. Both read as statements about the situations described. Neither is: they are statements about which sampler wrote the file, and 25 of the 26 members are the same items in both categories.
mechanism_as_described: One generation path writes the narrative and one summary record, and never emits the structured records the census counts. The narrative is not silent about the missing parties — it names them, describes their positions, and in one item assigns them numeric position values in a range, i.e. it plans exactly the records it then fails to produce. Downstream nothing distinguishes 'this item's record layer is empty because the generator stopped short' from 'this item's record layer is empty because nothing occupies these positions in the world it describes', because the absence is represented the same way in both cases: no records. A census that counts the empty ones therefore produces a number that looks like a measurement of the subject matter and is a measurement of the writing path. A second path in the same family emits neither kind of record and additionally stamps no generation-provenance record at all, so its items are blank on the very axis this examination used to detect the problem. The two affected categories overlap almost entirely because they are one gap counted twice, and a fix at the generator would move every member of a third, smaller category into a different category entirely.
detection_path: A pre-registered join, frozen before any join ran, of category membership against each item's per-item generation provenance, testing for concentration on two writing-side axes (which sampler, which prompt revision) with a family-wide multiple-comparison correction and a descriptive subject-matter axis declared in advance as non-discriminating. Two categories concentrated on both writing-side axes at corrected significance and on neither subject-matter axis. A hand-read of the two smallest categories quoted an in-file witness per member and split each member's two absence limbs separately, which is what showed one limb to be the writing gap and the other to be the item's genuine structure. Three controls ran alongside: a membership-sum check fired on a dropped member and on a duplicated member; a statistic pair flagged a planted single-stratum category and did not flag a seeded uniform draw; and a cross-check of the record layer against its parallel serialization matched on all 110 items with provenance.
consequence: Two published absence counts, 26 items each, were reading as properties of the subject matter and were properties of the writing path; a third small category is entirely artifact on one of its two limbs. The concentration is stark — one sampler contributes 16 of the members of each category while the majority sampler contributes 1 of 64 and 0 of 64 — so anyone comparing categories across the corpus would have been reading a sampler difference as a subject-matter difference. The items written by the path that stamps no provenance are unreadable on this axis in any future examination, not only this one.

symptom: The documented classification path states that every constraint is typed by a two-stage pipeline: a metric stage followed by a signature stage that may override it. Reading the canonical entry point confirms this — both stages run on every call. Three specific constraints never reach that entry point at all.
mechanism_as_described: A separate module adds clauses to the lookup predicate that the canonical path consults first. For three hardcoded historical constraints those clauses match and return a type directly, so the pipeline is never entered; some of them call a first-stage helper internally and thus receive metric typing with no signature stage at all. The clauses predate the two-stage architecture and were written to validate specific scenarios. Nothing in the code or the documentation marks them as an exception, so a reader who checks the canonical path — which is correct — concludes the invariant holds universally, and the check confirms exactly what it was pointed at.
detection_path: A structured verification pass that enumerated every module against the claimed invariants rather than reading the canonical path and confirming it.
consequence: Three constraints carry types produced by a different procedure than the one the architecture documents, with no marker at either the code or the document level. The divergence produces no error and no differing output shape.

symptom: A stored field is uniformly valid across an entire generated corpus: every record carries one of the two permitted values, none missing, none out of range. A mirrored copy of the same records, written by a different step, agrees with it exactly. That is consistent with the generator having produced clean values, and equally consistent with a repair step having overwritten every deviation before either artifact was written — and no surviving artifact separates the two.
mechanism_as_described: Between generation and storage sits a normalizer that maps unpermitted values onto permitted ones. Two of the values the model actually produces are both mapped onto the same permitted value, and that mapping returns without recording anything: no per-record note, no flag on the record, no log line. An aggregate counter does exist, but it counts replacements globally and keeps only a flat list of the values it replaced, with no record key to attach them to — and no committed file anywhere contains that counter, so even the aggregate is gone. The raw model output that carried the original values is consumed in memory during processing and discarded; the only artifact the generation run writes is the list of inputs it did not reach. The mirrored copy is written after repair from the same in-memory record, so the artifact a reader would naturally reach for as the pre-repair witness is post-repair too — and because its counts match the stored ones exactly, that comparison returns agreement and reads as confirmation.
detection_path: Asking what one specific downstream question would require, and then tracing backwards through the writers to see whether any artifact still holds it — before spending anything on the analysis that needed it. Four candidate sites were checked in turn rather than assumed: the normalizer (no per-record write), the aggregate statistic (no record key, and a search for its name across every committed file returned nothing), the raw model output (discarded in memory), and the mirrored copy (written after repair). Each is individually a plausible place for the information to survive; the finding is that none of them is.
consequence: One asymmetry between two models on this field — fifty-one against four — is real and settled, but the far larger group cannot be interpreted, because a value the model authored and a value assigned to it on the model's behalf are byte-identical in every surviving artifact. The information was not corrupted or lost through an error; it was never written, and everything that remains is well-formed and mutually consistent. Recovering it requires regenerating the corpus with the normalizer instrumented, converting a question that reads existing data into one that costs a generation run. In the meantime any validity check over the stored field returns clean, which is what it would return in either case.

symptom: A constraint that meets every condition for a diagnostic certificate is issued none. It classifies as ordinary, with no error, no warning, and no record that a certificate was considered and withheld.
mechanism_as_described: A per-item override value, authored as editorial data alongside the item and never intended as a classification input, flows into a derived quantity that is then compared against a hardcoded numeric exemption inside the certificate-issuing predicate itself. Because the exemption sits inside the predicate as a blocking condition rather than beside it as an annotation, failing it makes the entire predicate fail: the certificate is not issued rather than issued-with-a-flag. A second site one level lower does the same thing to an individual failure signal, removing it from the collected list so the certificate may still fire but on an incomplete basis. The identical architectural error had already been found and repaired once in a sibling predicate, where the fix was to demote the condition from a gate to collected evidence; the repair was applied to the one site that had been found and the pattern was not swept for.
detection_path: A targeted audit that enumerated every predicate capable of issuing or overriding a classification and traced, for each, whether any gate condition was fed by a test result rather than by raw measurement.
consequence: Authored editorial data can silently suppress a diagnostic verdict about the item it is attached to. The suppression is indistinguishable at every downstream read from the item simply not qualifying.

symptom: A finder reported 448 pairs of items satisfying a criterion that requires the two members to come from different subject areas. The pairs were well-formed, the count was stable across runs, and the report was read as a structural result. The subject area each item was compared on was not read from any recorded field: it was the text of the item's own identifier up to the first separator character. With almost as many distinct values as there were items, the requirement that two items differ was satisfied by nearly every pair.
mechanism_as_described: The gate asks for two items whose subject areas are unequal. The predicate supplying the subject area is named as though it reads the recorded one, and a recorded field does exist and is populated for 97 of 104 items — but the predicate ignores it and derives the value by parsing the identifier string instead. Identifiers are per-item, so the derived value is nearly unique: 86 distinct values over 104 items. An inequality test on a nearly-unique key is true for almost every pair, so the gate rejects almost nothing and its output is not a selection at all — it is the pair set, relabelled with a property it did not test for. Nothing in the output distinguishes the two cases: a pair list from a vacuous filter has exactly the shape of one from a discriminating filter, the counts are plausible, and they scale with the corpus the way a real result would. The derived value and the recorded one were shown to disagree item by item; and the recorded field is itself compound and granular, so exact-string inequality over it would have been over-permissive too.
detection_path: Not by reading the finder, but by counting the distinct values its subject-area predicate returns over the working corpus and comparing that count against the item count. The near-equality is the diagnosis: a key with nearly one value per item cannot support an inequality gate, whatever the gate is called. Only then was the predicate's definition read, to locate where the value came from, and individual items listed beside their recorded subject area to show the two disagree.
consequence: Every pair the finder had ever emitted carried a claim it never tested — 'these come from different subject areas' meant only 'their identifiers begin with different words.' On a larger corpus the same gate produced 68,730 pairs. It also disabled a planned check: the design intended to use known-matching pairs as a positive control, and those pairs share identifiers and therefore derive the same subject area, so the gate would reject exactly the cases that were supposed to prove it works — the control could not be run through the finder at all. Because the subsystem emits two products from one run, a clean result on the other product would have been read as validating both; the two had to be separated explicitly in the reporting so that several passing checks could not be summarized as 'subsystem validated' while half of it was known broken.
